entities.summary: Baku Oil Boom, a transformative movement in Azerbaijan (1846–1914). Emerged from First modern oil well drilled at Bibi-Heybat near Baku and Treaty of Turkmenchay completes the partition of Azerbaijan. Catalyzed Baku produces over half the world's oil supply and Red Army invades and sovietizes Azerbaijan.
